# T. C. Dirtworks

> T. C. Dirtworks is a full-service excavation company in the Charleston Tri-County area of South Carolina, with nearly a decade of earthworks experience. The owner is Timothy (Tim) Campbell.

The company takes on excavation and the site work that goes with it, and strives for perfection on every job. Free estimates are available by phone, email, or the form on the website.

## Services

- Excavation: digging and removing earth for foundations, utilities, and other below-grade work
- Grading: shaping soil to the elevations a site needs, including leveling and sloping the ground
- Land clearing: removing trees, brush, and surface debris so a piece of ground can be worked
- Site prep: getting a property ready for construction, from clearing through rough shaping of the site
- Drainage: moving water off a property with grading, swales, ditches, or pipe
- Trenching: opening trenches for utilities, footings, and drainage lines
- Demolition: taking down structures and clearing the material that comes out of that work
- Hauling: loading and transporting soil, debris, and other materials to or from a job
- Driveways: building or rebuilding a driveway, including grading and placing base material

## Service area

Charleston County, Berkeley County, and Dorchester County, South Carolina.
